deviceType: Reduced pressure zone assembly — selected official service parts
title: Watts 009 and LF009 repair parts by model revision and size
description: Match a Watts 009 or LF009 assembly to published cover, first-check, and relief-valve service references while keeping M2, M3, size, and flood-sensor variants separate.
summary: Watts 009 parts are not universal across the 009, 009M2, 009M3, LF009, and sensor variants. This record exposes only the official service references whose model, size, and component boundary are explicit.
statusNote: This is intentionally not a universal 009 rebuild selector. Confirm the full body marking, nominal size, lead-free designation, and whether the assembly has a sensor or special cover before using any part reference.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure zone assembly with first check, second check, central relief valve, and service cover
identifiers: Read the whole label: 009, LF009, 009M2, and 009M3 have different published part compatibility.
A cover kit, first-check kit, and relief-valve kit address separate components; a matching body size is not enough.
Flood-sensor and connection accessories are not internal repair kits and should not be substituted for one.
